subject: Quick follow-up: still a priority? (short fit check)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Wells <ethan.wells@storify.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + 3 quick fit questions (Storify AI)

Hi Ethan — great to connect earlier today. Quick recap and a very short ask so we can prioritize next steps. Attaching the discovery recap and a draft mutual action plan (MAP).

Key items from our call:
- Current blockers: integration with in-house vector store, compliance window for PII retention (30–60 days), and latency SLO target of <=120ms for chat.
- Ideal pilot: 3 endpoints (search, chat, rerank), ~5k qps bursts expected during business hours, initial dataset is partially anonymized support transcripts.
- Success metric: 35% reduction in avg token cost per relevant response and maintaining pass-rate on our quality evals.

Three quick fit questions (one-line answers appreciated):
1) Is supporting an on-prem/VPC private deployment a hard requirement for Q3?
2) How important is streaming (token-level) vs batched responses for your UX? (critical / nice-to-have)
3) Do you have an internal owner for procurement/legal that we should include now? (name/email)

If it helps, Ben can jump on a 15-minute call to walk through the MAP and tradeoffs between Dedicated vs Private. Proposed times: Wed 4/21 10:00am PT or Thu 4/22 2:30pm PT.

Attachments:
- discovery-recap.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
- map-draft-20270420.csv (CSV, 8KB)

Thanks — looking forward to your quick take.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Account Executive
